description: Ministry of Youth and Sports - Cancel the registration of the Sambo Federation of Sri Lanka
categorisation: This gazette content involves the Minister of Youth and Sports exercising powers under the Sports Law No. 25 of 1973 to cancel the registration of specific sports federations. This constitutes a regulatory action under existing legislation, making it a Legal/Regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change. The mention of the minister's name does not include detailed portfolio responsibilities, and the core action is regulatory in nature.
